Commentary.Commentary: The Indian bowling was way below standard. Apart from Hardik Pandya and Ravindra Jadeja, all the bowlers were taken to the cleaners and their fielding was also mediocre. Towards the end, the English batsmen ran havoc and amassed 105 runs off the last 8 overs. It's a target which requires serious batting. India have the batting resources to overhaul it and England will be aware of the danger that Kohli and his boys possess. Promises to be an intriguing chase. Do join us in a short while.

Joe Root then took the command of the innings in his hands and stroked a fluent 78. He was involved in a few useful partnerships with Roy, Morgan, Buttler and Stokes. Jos Buttler and Joe Root got out in quick succession which allowed India a sniff to restrict the visiting team but out came Ben Stokes and he started to counterattack from the word go. He cracked a quickfire fifty and was involved in a brisk 33-ball 73 stand with Moeen Ali.

Powerful batting show by England! They have notched up their highest ODI total against India and it's a monumental task in front of the home team now. The English batting initiated superbly after put into bat and Jason Roy, in particular, looked in fine touch. His innings, however, was cut short as India tried to claw their way back.

A bye to end the innings! 12 off the final one, 105 from last 8, informs Nasser Hussain on air, phew! A low full toss angled across, Willey fails to put bat on ball and they look to steal a bye. Dhoni underarms it towards the striker's end but misses the shy. ENGLAND FINISH ON 350/7!
Full toss on the pads, clipped through mid-wicket by David. A couple picked up. 10 already from the over, one to go.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for just a single.
Full outside off, jammed towards Yuvraj at point for one.

SIX! What a shot! His bottom hand came off but still it cleared the fence. It's that kind of a day for the Indians in the field. Slower one around middle, Willey tries to hit it across the line but is deceived by the pace there, still carries on with the shot and sends the ball over the square leg fence for a maximum.

Just short off long off. A low full toss on off, Chris chips it towards long off and it falls short of the man there. A single of the first ball. This is also the highest score for England vs India in ODIs.
Some fielding changes are being done. Bumrah to bowl the last over of the innings, how many more can the English tail get in?
Very full outside off, almost a yorker, Woakes slices it towards Kedar at backward point for a single.
Full on middle, Willey milks it towards long on to get off the mark.
David Willey comes in next!

OUT! Bowled 'em! Yadav fires in a yorker on the stumps, Moeen Ali tries to play the premeditated reverse sweep but misses and the ball goes off the pads and crashes into the timber. No celebration from them as they know damage is already done.
Keeps it nice and full on middle, worked away towards the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Woakes joins the party! A length ball served outside off, Woakes doesn't moves an inch as he just lofts it cleanly over the cover fielder. The man there tries to take it with a leap but had no chance to stop that one.
Yorker on the stumps, Moeen jams it out towards covers for a single.
Full on middle and leg, whipped across the line on the leg side for one. Last 6 overs, 85 runs have come. 2 overs still to go.
FOUR LEG BYES! Nothing going India's way. Bumrah bowls a yorker on the leg stump, Ali tries to flick but misses and the ball kisses his pads and beats Dhoni to find the fence at fine leg.
SIX! Moeen Ali is not done yet! Back of a length ball outside off, Ali stays put, swivels a touch and flat-bats the pull over mid-wicket for a biggie. The crowd is absolutely silent at the moment.
Fuller and fired on the base of the off stump, Woakes slices it behind point for a single.
Pitches it up on middle and leg, it's jammed out towards long on for a single.
Chris Woakes walks in next, replacing Stokes!

OUT! In the air... gone! A massive 73-run stand off just 33 balls comes to an end. Kohli takes a breather now. Bumrah bowls a short ball on off, it rises off the deck. Stokes looks to pull this but the bounce gets bigger of him. He miscues it high in the air towards deep mid-wicket where Umesh Yadav takes a safe catch. A fine, fine knock from Ben!
FOUR! Wheels have come off! Too full in length and around off, Moeen makes room and smashes it through point for a crunching boundary. 20 off the over, 72 in the last 5!
Fullish and drilled down through mid off for a run.
Worked through mid-wicket and took a single.
FOUR! Moeen joins the fun! Short and wide outside off, Moeen stands tall, latches onto the room and smacks it over point for a cracking boundary. Dhoni has a chat with Kohli.
Spears in a fuller ball on middle and leg, Stokes is squared up and gets a leading edge through the cover region. A single taken.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. Two runs added to the total.
Free Hit coming up...
SIX! Welcome back into the attack, Yadav! A high full toss outside off, Stokes stays back and upper cuts it over third man for a biggie. No ball called for a waist high full toss.
Umesh Yadav is called back into the attack!
Turns it off his pads through mid-wicket for a single. 12 runs off the over, 52 in last 4.
A swing and a miss by Stokes. He was attempting a reverse batted shot against the back of a length ball.
7th ODI fifty for Ben Stokes!

SIX! Reaches his fifty in style! Bumrah delivers a fuller length ball outside off, Stokes attacks it with all his power and dispatches it over long on for a biggie. Powerful knock by Ben, off just 33 balls!
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Fullish and on middle, whipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Free Hit coming up...

DROPPED! Another full toss by Bumrah, very close to the batsman's waist, Stokes swings his bat and gets a top edge. It balloons in the air but Kohli fails to take the catch at the cover region. It's called a no ball for height. Bumrah is lucky not to be taken off the attack as the first beamer he bowled was wide outside off and not deemed dangerous.
Full length ball angling away from the batsman, slower in pace, Stokes gets across the stumps to attempt the paddle shot but misses. He should be backing himself to clear the straighter boundaries.
Flatter and shorter, slapped to sweeper cover for one. 14 off the over, 40 in last 3! England are on the charge!
Shortish and punches through wide mid on for a couple of runs.

SIX! Loopy full ball on middle, Stokes reaches out with a big stride, is deceived in flight a bit and hoists it over the bowler's head for a biggie. Doesn't quite middle it but still high and handsome.
Rocks back and punches it through covers for one.
FOUR! Ashwin drags his length short again, outside off, Ali makes use of the depth of the crease and spanks it over extra cover for a boundary.
Flatter and shorter outside off, punched to short cover.
Ravichandran Ashwin is brought back into the attack.
Back of a length delivery on off, Stokes goes back and punches it through extra cover for two. 16 runs off the over.
Bangs in a short ball around off, Moeen top edges his pull shot and it falls safely in the deep at square leg. One run added to the total.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.

SIX! High and handsome! Fuller in length and in the hitting zone for Stokes, he gives it the full whack of his bat after goes deep inside the crease and launches it over long on for a maximum. Takes full toll of the Free Hit!
Free Hit coming up...

High full toss again, outside off, Stokes swings and misses. Called a no ball for waist height full toss. One more and he will be out of the attack. Has already bowled one high full toss in this spell.
FOUR! Just a reaction shot but he does well to middle it. Slower delivery, short and around off, Stokes swings his bat and pulls it behind square leg for a boundary. He is looking dangerous.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Moeen eases it through wide mid on for one.
Tossed up ball on off, driven off the front foot to mid off. End of the over, 10 runs off it!
SIX! Stokes goes on the attack. Receives a fuller length ball around middle, makes room and lofts it nonchalantly over extra cover for a biggie.
Hangs back and punches it to long on for a single.
Presses forward and drives it down the ground for one.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Moeen gets back and lifts it over mid-wicket for a run.
Slider around off, skidding in, Stokes gets back and hits it to sweeper cover for a run.
Too full in length and on middle, Ben flicks it through mid-wicket and collects a single.
Bumrah runs in from around the wicket and angles in a sharp full toss around off, Stokes pushes it off his front foot to Kohli at extra cover.
Moeen Ali strides in next.

OUT! Root is out of here! Another set batsman gone and it's a big blow to England. A slower full ball outside off, 114 kph, Root clears his front leg and aims to clear long on. But he fails to get the timing right and Pandya in the deep grabs a fine catch near the rope. A good knock by Joe comes to an end.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
One more full toss, wide outside off, Stokes reaches out and cuts it straight to point.
Out off a Free Hit! Bumrah delivers another full toss, Root chips it in the air and Dhawan at long off takes the catch. He immediately sends it back in play and they take a run.

Probably slips out of Bumrah's hand, a high full toss outside off, Stokes throws his bat at it and top edges it towards third man. One run added to the total. It's signalled a no ball and Free Hit coming up...
Jasprit Bumrah is inserted back into the attack.
Strides forward and eases it to long on for one.
Full and outside off, driven to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

That missed everything! Jadhav bowls it flatter and quicker around middle and leg, Stokes goes deep inside the crease to punch it through the line but misses and is hit on the pads. It ricochets and goes very closely past the stumps to long stop. A couple of leg byes taken.
Advances down the track and digs out a very full ball to long on for a run.
Quicker full ball on middle, helped to mid-wicket for a single.
Powerplay 3 time. Five fielders are allowed outside the ring now.
Walks down the track and clips it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Well played! Slower through the air, full and spinning down leg, Root kneels and nails his sweep shot past short fine leg for a boundary.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and pushes it back to Ashwin.
Flatter and on middle, stroked down to long on for a single.
Loopy and around leg, Root nudges it wide of short fine leg for a single.
Flighted ball on middle, whipped through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Ravichandran Ashwin is brought back into the attack.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to mid on. Dot ball to end the over.
Loopy full ball on off, driven back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Misfield by Bumrah! Very poor delivery, short and angling down the leg side, it stays a touch low too, Stokes goes back and drag-pulls it past the diving Bumrah at short fine leg for a boundary.
Flatter and quicker around off, Root reverse sweeps it towards backward point for a single.
Bowls it with a round-arm action and lands it on middle and leg from around the wicket, Stokes goes deep inside the crease and punches it to long on for one.
Kedar Jadhav is back on.
Fullish and on middle, turned off the pads to mid-wicket for one.
Ben Stokes is the new batsman in.

OUT! Buttler departs and it's a big wicket for India. The hit on the last ball appears to have rattled Buttler. He receives a length delivery outside off and tries to spank it over mid off. But fails to time it well and hands a straightforward catch to Dhawan at mid off who grabs it with a jump. End of a 63-run stand and it's a timely breakthrough for the home team.

Bang on the helmet! Pandya goes short around off, Buttler is early into the pull shot and hence misses. He his hit on the helmet but no harm is done. The bowler quickly checks the well being of the batsman.
Pandya once again angles in a full ball on off, Root swings his bat across the line but gets it away off the bottom half of the bat to mid off.
Full and angling into the batsman, Buttler drives it through mid off for a run.
Shortish and outside off, smashed square of the wicket on the off side for one.
Hardik Pandya is back on, replacing Jadeja.
Driven towards the long off region. They pick up a single.
Walks down the track and drills it to mid off where Kohli makes a fine diving stop.
Buttler has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Shortish on off, cut straight to point.
SIX! Clean as a whistle! Loopy full ball on off, Buttler shimmies down the track and powers it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Flatter on off, punched to covers where Kohli misfielded again. No run conceded though.
Flighted on off, driven through the line past the diving mid off fielder for a run.
Quicker full ball outside off, hit firmly past the point fielder for one.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Loopy and angling in around off, Joe eases it down to long off for one.
Full flighted ball on off, forced down through mid off for a single. 50-run stand comes up!
Flatter and fuller wide outside off, Root reaches out for it and slaps it to sweeper cover for one.
Full and around off, Root drives it towards Kohli at covers. The Indian skipper once again fails to collect it cleanly. Another single picked up.
Full and darted around off, Joe drives it straight to Kohli at covers.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
A full toss and a misfield too! Yuvi bowls a low full toss outside off, Root drills it towards Kohli at short extra cover who makes a meal of it. A fumble allows them to get a single.
Touch short and outside off, punched once again through covers for a single.
Starts with a tossed up ball around off, there's a bit of width and it's enough for Buttler to slap it past covers for a couple.
Yuvrj Singh is asked to roll his arm. Can he break the partnership?
Drinks are on the field!
Flatter and quicker through the air, Joe Root punches it back to Jadeja. A dot ball to end the over!

Good running! Touch short and skids in a bit, Root gets back and flicks it towards wide long on. Pandya in the deep gets across to his right, picks it up with one hand and then throws it at the bowler's end. Jadeja tries to deflect the throw on the stumps and does so but Buttler was easily in. Quick legs! Two runs!
Drops it short on middle, Buttler reads it and immediately rocks back and pulls it towards square leg. There is a protection in the deep so he will get only a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On middle and off, Root goes back and punches it down to long on for a single.
SIX! Tonked! That was right off the meat! Tossed up around off, Root gets down on his rear knee and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. Superb batting, this!
Good length delivery, angling in, Buttler shuffles way across to play the paddle shot but fails to get any bat on it.
Shortish length served outside off, Jos punches it straight to man at point.
Driven towards the mid on region. One run added to the total.
18th ODI fifty for Joe Root!

That's fifty for Joe Root! On the pads, Joe clips it through mid-wicket and comes back for a double. Raises his bat. He wants to get a big one under his belt. The stage is set and he would hope to make the most of it.
Leg bye! Angles in a length ball on the pads, Buttler comes down the track to work it away on the leg side but misses as the ball lobs up off the pads towards the off side. A leg bye picked up.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched square of the wicket on the off side for a single.

SIX! How easy he made that look! Loopy ball around off, Buttler goes inside out over covers. Makes thrilling connection and eases it over the fence for half a dozen. You can expect him to shift gears now. Jadeja now has figures of - 8-0-34-1!
Flatter ball on middle, Buttler punches it back to Jadeja who fumbles a bit but the batsmen don't run.
Comes down the track and punches it towards short cover.
A slider around middle and leg, nudges through the leg side for a single.
Leg bye! Pushes it slower through the air around the pads, Buttler looks to flick but misses as the ball rolls off the pads towards the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
Flattish around off, knocked down to long off for a single.
Touch short on the stumps, Root pulls it towards wide mid on for another single.
Slightly short and angling in, clipped towards mid on for a single.
Length ball on off, punched straight to Kohli at short extra cover.
Pandya hurls a short ball outside off, Root stays put, opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Root comes down a bit and ends up punching it towards covers.
Back of a length ball outside off, Buttler rocks back and cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, Root once again bunts it back to Jaddu. Just a single from the over, a good one!
Pushes it slower through the air, JR stays back and defends it back to the bowler.
Gets back and cuts but finds the fielder at point.
Shortish around off, dabbed just past Dhoni for a quick single.
Landed outside off, steered towards third man for a single.
Tossed up around off, pushed towards covers.
Full around off, driven towards mid off.
Kohli is nicely shuffling his bowlers. The run rate is in check and the good thing for them is that Buttler has just walked in. So he might take a bit of time to get his eye in.
Fuller on the stumps, Jos gets across and flicks it towards mid on for a single.
On a length and outside off, Buttler pushes it towards the fielder at point.
JB has punched that ball through the offside.
Landed outside off, dabbed down to third man for an easy single.
Touch short and outside off, Jos gets an inside edge down to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Sweet! Fuller and angling in on the pads, Buttler gets across and flicks it through mid-wicket to find the fence. A good way to start the over.

FOUR! This isn't the first time Root has played this kind of a shot in the game! Floated ball outside off, Root gets down on one knee and plays the reverse paddle over Dhoni for a boundary to spoil Jadeja's over.
Full and fires on off, driven once again towards the man at mid off.
Around off, pushed straight to mid off.
Drops it a touch short and outside off, Buttler taps it towards the off side and takes a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up around off, driven towards mid off for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja is back on.
Jos Buttler is the new man in, replacing Morgan.

OUT! The decision is overturned! Eoin Morgan has to make the long way back to the pavilion. On a length and just outside off, the English skipper tries to poke at it and the ball is collected behind by MSD. He takes it and they all go up in an appeal but the umpire stays unmoved. The hosts take the review as there was some noise and the replays confirm there was an edge. A crucial 49-run stand comes to an end.
The Indians have taken a caught behind appeal against Morgan upstairs. Dhoni is confident and when he's, the batsman is always in trouble. DRS time!
Short of a length ball outside off, Root pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Joe once again gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls behind the stumps. He wanted a single but Pandya quickly gets to the ball and denies them.
Angles in a length ball on off, Root tries to run it down but gets an inside edge which goes past the stumps to Dhoni who collects it on the bounce.
Back of a length outside off, Morgan glides it down to third man for a single.
Short of a length ball outside off, Root cuts it through backward point for a single.
Floated ball on the stumps, Root gets down and sweeps it through short fine leg for a single.
Tossed up around off, it's very full, knocked down to long on for a single.
Darted around leg, swept through fine leg for a single.
Full around middle and off, bunted back to the bowler.
Bowls it with a sligning action on the pads, it's swept towards short fine leg.
Tossed up around off, Morgan lunges forward and drives it towards long off for a single.
Kedar Jadhav, the man with the golden-arm, is into the attack.
Leg bye! On the pads, EM misses his flick as the ball rolls off the pads towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short of a length ball, angling down, Morgan shuffles a touch and pulls it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Shortish again and outside off, Root slaps it through square of the wicket on the off side. Root wanted the second but Umesh in the deep is quick to deny him. Only a single picked up.
A touch shortish outside off, Eoin walks down and punches it through point for a single.

Fuller in length and outside off, Morgan drives it towards covers and sets off. Umesh Yadav throws it towards the keeper and due to the bad bounce Dhoni fails to collect it. The ball hits his pads and rolls further and they take another run.
Fuller in length and outside off, drilled through point for a single.
Hardik Pandya is brought back into the attack!
Flattish around middle and off, swept through mid-wicket for another single. Eight from the over, a good one for the hosts.
Full on the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Strays it on the pads, that's again a quicker one, Morgan just tries to use the pace. He stays back and helps it on its way down to fine leg. Bumrah tries his best but to no avail.
Quicker one around leg, Root gets down on one knee and pulls it past the man at short fine leg for a single.
Slows it through the air, Root could only punch it back to Ashwin.
Around middle and off, a touch flatter as well, punched down to long off for one.
Shortish on off, Root defends it towards the man at short cover.

FOUR! Back of a length delivery on middle, sits up at a nice height too. Root goes back and hammers the pull through mid-wicket. Nobody in the deep and the English run machine fetches himself a boundary here.
Goes back and tucks it towards the leg side for a single.
Angles it in on middle, worked wide of the mid on fielder for a brisk single.
Outside off, Joe mistimes his drive to mid on.
Good length ball on off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Slightly quicker through the air, Root flicks it to mid-wicket and scampers across for a single.
Around off, pushed down to long off for a single. Good sensible batting, a biggie and then a single to get off the strike.

SIX! Nailed it! Floats it up around off, Morgan says I have had enough, he sits down and fetches it from outside off. The slog sweep has enough meat to sail over the mid-wicket fence for half a dozen of runs.
Loopy delivery on the pads, Morgan flicks it delicately down to fine leg for a single.
Around middle and leg, Root comes a step froward and works it through mid on for a single.
Floated ball around middle and leg, Root sits down and across to paddle it fine down the leg side. Rahul in the deep cuts it off as the batsmen settle for a brace.
Landed outside off, Morgan stands tall and just dabs it in front of the first slip fielder. Brilliant over this from Bumrah, just a couple from it.
Good length ball on the pads, tucked towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Morgan is getting frustrated! Sees the little bit of width offered from Bumrah and tries to come down the track for a drive. Ends up getting an inside edge on the pads.
Good length ball on middle, Morgan looks to play this across the line but misses and is hit on the pads.
Shortish on off, Root stays back and slaps it through square of the wicket on the off side for one.
Wide! Bangs in a short ball outside off, it rises further off the deck, Root leaps and tries to play the ramp shot but it was too high for him. The umpire rightly calls it a wide.
Angles in a full length ball from around off, Root lunges forward to defend but gets a thick inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls behind to the keeper. Not very far from the off stump.
Jasprit Bumrah is back into the attack!
Drops it short on middle, Root camps back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, punched through covers for an easy single.
Once again bowls a tossed up delivery, Morgan once again plays it off the inner part of the bat towards the bowler.
Loops it up outside off, gives this a lot of flight, Morgan looks to drive but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards mid-wicket.
Slower through the air around middle and leg, Morgan comes forward and nudges it towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery around off, it's bunted back to Ash.
Floated ball around off, Joe presses forward and defends it down safely. A superb over from Jadeja, this.
Tossed it up around middle and off, Eoin milks it down to long on to get off the mark.
Full and around off, Morgan prods forward and defends it down.
The English skipper, Eoin Morgan walks in next! Virat Kohli is on the attack and has employed a slip and leg slip.

OUT! Stumped! Jadeja bowls it quicker through the air around off, Roy comes down the track to get to the pitch but the ball sneaks through his bat and pad and MS Dhoni behind the stumps collects it cleanly before whipping the bails off. A much-needed breakthrough for the Indians as Roy was looking threatening out there.
This time he works it past short fine leg for one.
Around middle and leg, Root looks to sweep but gets it off the inner half of the bat towards short fine leg.
Flatter again and outside off, Root slaps it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Floats it up around off, Root looks to defend it off the front foot but fails to do so.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Flatter and around off, Jason Roy gets back and punches it past mid off. Beats Jadeja there and earns a boundary to his name.

In the air... dropped! Floated ball around off, Roy gets down and across to play the reverse paddle but doesn't get it off the meat. The ball lobs towards short third man where Yadav moves backward but misjudges it. In the end tries to take it with his right hand but the ball doesn't stick. A couple taken and Roy gets a reprieve.
Tossed up around middle and leg, pushed straight back to the bowler.
Drinks break.
Flattish and shortish on off, Root dabs it down to short third man.
Loopy full ball on off, Root kneels and slogs it in front of the square leg. Bumrah does the fielding in the deep and they take a brace.
Flat again, full around off, it's punched off the back foot to covers.
Quicker full ball on off, defended back to the bowler off the front foot.
Fires a flatter ball on middle, Roy punches it to long on for one.
Floated full ball on middle, Root gets on the front foot and nudges it through mid on for a single.
On middle and leg, eased through mid-wicket for a single.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Wide! Fires one down the leg side, Root tries to sweep but misses. Good take by MSD.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Quicker full on off, driven towards extra cover.
Flatter on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Strides forward and drives it towards covers.
Flighted on off, spinning away, Root gets forward and pushes it to point.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Gets on the back foot and punches it square of the wicket on the off side for a run.
Roy dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Quicker and on middle, flicked through back square leg for one.
Flatter ball around leg, Roy plays the reverse sweep and Pandya moves across to his left from short third man to stop the ball.  One run added to the total.
Loopy ball on off, Roy lunges and pushes it towards short third man. Dot ball to end the over.
Jason has played it fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Sliding down and it's eased behind square leg for one.
Tossed up ball on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Wide! Down the leg side, probably bowled with a leg spinner's action, the batsman fails to flick and the umpire stretches his arms.
Flatter this time, outside off, punched back to Ashwin.
Flighted full ball on middle, from around the wicket, Root forces it down to long on for a single.
Ravichandran Ashwin is brought into the attack as well. Spin from both ends now...
Fires another flatter delivery outside off, it's punched back to the bowler.
Excellent delivery, an arm ball around off and skidding through, Roy goes on the back foot and just manages to keep it out on the leg side.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it through covers for one.
Quicker and fuller on leg, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Innovative! Loopy full ball on off, Root premeditates his shot this time and reverse paddles it over the keeper for a boundary.
Flighted and full around middle, Root defends it by getting forward.
Fuller and on off, Roy opens up a bit in his stance and pushes it towards mid-wicket.
High full toss on off, Roy mistimes his shot to mid off.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
FOUR! Fine shot! Bumrah offers width and serves it short outside off, Roy goes on his back foot and spanks it through point for a boundary.

Fullish and angling into the batsman, Root clips it through mid-wicket and runs across for a quick single. They were looking for the second run as well but Kedar Jadhav in the deep does an exceptional job to send the throw quickly to the bowler. Big cheer from the crowd for the local lad.
Darts in a full ball on off, Root gets forward and defends it solidly to the off side.
Goes a bit slower through the air and lands it a touch slower on off, Root gets back and strokes it through covers for one.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They have run through for a single.
Forces a full ball down to long off and picks up a single.
Full floated ball on middle, it's helped off the pads to short mid-wicket.
Flatter and around off, Roy goes on the back foot and punches it through extra cover for a single.
Flighted full ball on off, Root gets on the front foot and drives it through covers for a single.
Time for spin as Ravindra Jadeja is asked to roll his arm. A slip is in place for him.
Powerplay 2 signalled. 4 fielders are allowed outside the circle now.
Length ball in the line of the stumps, it's defended off the pads to mid-wicket.
6th ODI fifty for Jason Roy!
FOUR! That's put away nicely! Short of a length ball on off, Roy rides the bounce and nails his pull shot over square leg for a boundary. Races to his fifty and raises his bat. Top knock so far!
Jadeja is warming up...
Fullish on off, Roy pushes it with gentle hands to mid on. Dot ball.
Arrows a very full ball on middle, Root tries to flick but misses and it goes off his pads to backward square leg. A leg bye taken.
Width on offer outside off, Roy runs it down to third man for a single.

FOUR! What a shot! Roy is in his zone. A fractionally overpitched ball on middle, Jason just presents a straight bat and caresses it down the ground for a boundary. Didn't try to hit it hard, just timed it.
Fuller and outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Roy is batting beautifully here. Yadav's line has been very straight and Jason has punished him every time. On a length around middle, Roy gets back and closes the face of the bat to ease it through backward square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Short delivery, too straight in line, Roy gets on top of the bounce and pulls it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Beauty! A hint of inward shape there, from a length around off, Roy pushes at it tamely and it beats the inside edge of the bat.
Fuller in length outside off, Roy drives it to mid off where once again Kohli gets to the ball quickly. Tries to throw but slips in the process.

Very full and on off, Roy punches it down the ground and Kohli moves across to his right from mid off to stop the ball. Dives but the stop made is not clean and hence a run has been taken. Not sure whether the dive was needed there!
Bumrah comes steaming in but is asked to stop by Roy who has some issue with the sightscreen. Poor bowler will have to go back...

Fullish and outside off, it's driven off the front foot to wide of mid off. Kohli moves across to his left and makes a partial stop. He then gets up and chases it down. They manage to come back for the second.
Short and wide outside off, Jason throws his bat at it but fails to make any connection.
Digs in a short ball on middle, Root mistimes his pull shot in the air and it falls safely at deep backward square leg. A run taken and Root is off the mark.
Another watchful leave outside the off stump by Joe.
Starts with a good length delivery outside off, lovely line, Root covers the line and shoulders arms.
Jasprit Bumrah comes into the attack. He will have his tail up after inflicting a run out.
Slower delivery, on a length and around off, Roy picks it a shade late and defends it down near the surface.
Pitches it full and outside off, it's driven off the front foot to covers.
FOUR! Superb shot! Yadav is once again too straight in his line, on middle and leg, Roy flicks it beautifully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Bouncer well over the head of the batsman. Called a wide for height!
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The English run machine, Joe Root walks in next, replacing Hales.

OUT! Alex Hales is run out! All thanks to the brilliance of Jasprit Bumrah. Full length delivery around off, Roy tucks it off his pads to deep backward square leg and attempts for the second run. Bumrah in the deep latches onto the ball and sends in a bullet throw at the non-striker's end. It finds the stumps as Hales tries to drag his bat inside the crease. The Indians appeal and the umpire refers it upstairs. The replays show that Hales is inches short of the crease. First wicket for India and the home crowd is absolutely ecstatic.
Appeal for a run out, it's referred upstairs...

FOUR! Pristine timing! Good length ball angling into the batsman, Roy closes the face of the bat at the right time and times his flick shot to perfection. Finds the gap through mid-wicket and no stopping it after that.
Angles in a full ball on off, Hales gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it back solidly.
FOUR! Wrong line and punished! Good length ball angling down the leg side, Hales gets across a bit and nudges it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off, Hales slaps it through the line but finds Rahul at cover-point.
Roy delicately works it fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Good fielding but still a run. Full in length and outside off, Hales pushes it towards extra cover where Yuvraj dives and deflects it to mid off. Kohli at the edge of the circle has moved across to his left in anticipation and hence a run taken.
Play and a miss! Width on offer outside off, a lazy waft by Hales, away from his body and gets beaten. His feet didn't move there!
A little short in length and on middle, Hales turns inside the crease with the pull shot and under edges it down to fine leg for one.
Bouncer on this occasion, around middle, Hales ducks underneath it.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Turns it off his pads to square leg and rotates the strike.

Lands it on a length and around off, Hales gets back and mistimes his shot towards mid on. They scamper across for a sharp single as the fielder attacks the ball. He lets the ball out but misses the stumps as Alex speeds inside the crease. Good intent from the English boys!
On the pads, a bit short and pulled through backward square leg for one.
Extra bounce around off, Roy takes the bottom hand off the handle and it goes off his gloves. The ball rolls behind in front of the slip cordon and Hales calls him quickly for a single.

In the air... safe! Pandya surprises the batsman with a short ball outside off, Hales fails to middle his pull shot and it goes in the air towards deep backward square leg. Ashwin moves across to his right in the deep but the ball falls wide of him. One run added to the total.
Fullish again, around off, Alex pushes it off his front foot to covers.
Gets forward to a full ball and defends it quietly towards mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Beaten! Back of a length ball around off, straightening a touch, Hales pushes inside the line and misses.

Fullish in length and around off, Roy drives it off the outer half of the bat to mid off. Kohli fields the ball and has an immediate shy at the striker's end. Yadav is in the line of fire and immediately ducks to avoid getting hit. The ball whizzes past the stumps at the striker's end as Roy quickly plonks his foot inside the crease.
Length delivery on off, Roy taps it down to cover-point.

NOT OUT! Missing leg. Yadav sticks to a straighter line, bowls it full and around middle and leg, angling down, Roy fails to flick it on the leg side and is hit on the pads. They appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Hales and Roy have a chat and the latter signals for the DRS. The replays show that the impact is within line but it's going on to miss the leg stump. Well reviewed, Roy!
Jason Roy is adjudged lbw. He is reviewing it.
Wide! Yadav is struggling with his line here. Goes shopping down the leg side with a length ball, Roy tries flicking but misses.
FOUR! That's a very poor delivery by Umesh. Bangs it short and wide outside off, Roy chances his arms and slaps it over point for a boundary. The crowd goes silent.
Once again Yadav is on the pads, Hales eases it to fine leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Just a shade short and around leg, Roy gets on top of the bounce and nudges it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Fullish and it's put in the region just around off, Hales strides forward and defends it to the off side.
On a length and angling in around off, Alex stands back to get behind the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Too straight in line on this occasion, Roy turns it off his pads to fine leg and collects a single.
FOUR! Much better this time! Pandya bowls it full and Jason takes his front leg to the pitch of the ball before driving it elegantly through covers for a boundary.

FOUR! It's aerial but through the gap. Full in length and outside off, Roy is lured into the drive and gets it aerially through extra cover for a boundary. A similar shot Mitchell Marsh attempted in the ongoing game at the MCG and was caught, thereby bagging a golden duck.
Starts with a shortish ball outside off, a hint of away shape, Roy lets it through to the keeper.
Hardik Pandya to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Bowls it on a length and in the line of the stumps, Hales covers the line and pushes it back towards the bowler.
Wide! Back of a length ball angling down the leg side, Alex tries to get some bat behind it but fails to connect. The umpire stretches his arms.
Drifting down the leg side, Roy fails to work it across the line and it goes off his pads to the left of Dhoni. A leg bye taken.

FOUR! A touch short and outside off, Roy pushes at it away from his body and gets it away off the outside half of the bat. It's wide of second slip this time and Pandya in the deep fails to make a clean stop. The onfield umpire has a little chat with the third umpire and gives it a boundary. England are away!
Beauty of a delivery! Lands it on a length just around off, Roy is squared up in his back foot defense and is beaten all ends up.
Yadav immediately adjusts his length to go full and angles it in on middle and off, Roy gets behind the line and pushes it to mid on.

Starts with a good length delivery in the channel outside off, Roy decides to leave it but is late in taking his bat away. It goes off the toe end of the bat to second slip. The fielder dives to make the stop.

The national anthems are done and dusted and it's now time for the real action to kick off. There is the Indian team huddle near the boundary rope. Out come the English openers Alex Hales and Jason Roy. Umesh Yadav to start off with the bowling proceedings. He has a couple of slips in place. Here we go...
The players are out for their respective national anthems.
ENGLAND PLAYING XI - Alex Hales, Jason Roy, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan(c), Jos Buttler(w), Ben Stokes, Moeen Ali, Chris Woakes, Adil Rashid, David Willey, Jake Ball.
INDIA PLAYING XI - Shikhar Dhawan, Lokesh Rahul, Virat Kohli(c), MS Dhoni(w), Yuvraj Singh, Kedar Jadhav, Hardik Pandya, Ravichandran Ashwin, Ravindra Jadeja, Jasprit Bumrah, Umesh Yadav.

EOIN MORGAN says even he would have liked to bowl first. But now would look to set a good total for the home side. Further says it's a different challenge in front of them and says they would quickly look to adapt to the conditions. Opines that they have got good practice in the warm-up games and hopefully they display good show here today. On the playing XI, he says it's always a good headache picking the playing XI. Informs that Dawson, Billings, Plunkett and Bairstow miss out today.

VIRAT KOHLI says they will bowl first as it is a bit damp and so they want to take full advantage of it. Adds the dew might come later in the evening and that should help them as well. Further says they don't have much time before the Champions Trophy so they are treating each game as a knockout. Informs us that Pandey, Bhuvneshwar, Rahane and Mishra miss out for the opening clash.
TOSS - Virat Kohli spins the coin. Eoin Morgan calls it incorrectly. INDIA WILL BOWL!

PITCH REPORT - There is a bit of grass but not that much as it was during India vs Sri Lanka T20I game. Conitues saying there are a few patches that would assist the seamers. Adds it's a two-paced wicket and the carry will be more when the ball lands near the grassy area. Informs still it reamins to be a good batting surface. Adds there won't be any dew and India would look to bat if they win the toss, reckon Sunil Gavaskar and Nasser Hussain in their pitch report.

For England, they have Eoin Morgan and he has a powerful batting line-up capable of taking any attack to the cleaners. His side would need to forget what happened in Tests and need to start afresh. Can they put up a fight and start the New Year with a bang? Or will the Indians continue with the momentum. Hello and a warm welcome for the 1st ODI in Pune. The all-important toss is on its way. Stay tuned...

The Test series is done and dusted and England after taking a much-needed break are back and they now clash with the Men in Blue for the 3-match ODI and T20I series. The onus will be on Virat Kohli as he has been handed over the captaincy and it would be highly interesting to see how he fares with added responsibility on his shoulders.
